name: Tantei no Susume ~Kurenai no Reppu Hen
original_name: 探偵のすすめ～紅の烈風編
source:
My name is Miki Fujiwara. I'm a totally normal cute high schooler.
Things were pretty normal for us until one day at the library, an arrow came shooting!
It carried the warning of a future crime by someone known as "Red Cap":
the night after next, a bomb will destroy the east campus!?

High school detective Miki and her sidekick Sato-kun are on the case!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE089408.html]DLsite English[/url]]
